name: Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical products in Japan, Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through metal surface treatment agents and equipment, electronic materials, automotive chemical products, and industrial chemicals segments. The company provides plating chemicals that are used in the production of electronic components for use in computers, office equipment, mobile phones, and digital appliances; tin and solder plating additives; and automatic control equipment for chemicals used in printed wiring board, plastic plating, flat-panel display, and plating process.
